page_title: BET 3-0 MAL | Betis v Mallorca 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+1' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.

89' Pablo Garcia (Betis) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Lucas Bergstrom pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
88' A quickly taken corner by Betis.
87' Nelson Deossa (Betis) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Betis have a corner.
86' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) earns the yellow card.
86' Nelson Deossa (Betis) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
83' The game has come to an end for Antony. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pablo Garcia (Betis).
83' A cross from a corner kick by Mallorca is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.

82' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Takuma Asano (Mallorca). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
81' Antony (Betis) commits a rough foul. Jesus Manzano stops the game and makes a call.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jan Virgili will be replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
79' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdon Prats (Mallorca) replacing Vedat Muriqi.
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.

78' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
77' Giovani Lo Celso will be replaced by Nelson Deossa (Betis).

76' Antony (Betis) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Lucas Bergstrom to get hold of the ball.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

72' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort. It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
69' Here is a change. Abde Ezzalzouli is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
69' Substitution. Marc Roca (Betis) in, Pablo Fornals out.
67' Antony (Betis) takes the corner kick, but Lucas Bergstrom reads it well and stops the effort.

66' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Betis.
65' The game is interrupted as Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is flagged offside.
64' It is time for a substitution. Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is on for Mateo Joseph.
64' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Sergi Darder and he is replaced by Pablo Torre (Mallorca).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch for Manu Morlanes.

62' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Lucas Bergstrom has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
61' A long pass finds Samu Costa (Mallorca) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
59' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies just over the bar. Unlucky!
56' Flag goes up against Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
51' Mallorca are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
48' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis). He is replaced by Valentin Gomez.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Antony (Betis) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

45+3' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. Betis have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+1' Natan (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
41' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

37' 3 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) and Antony gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 3:0.
34' 2 - 0 Goal! Antony (Betis) neatly controls a decent pass from Hector Bellerin. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 2:0.
30' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes it short.
29' The ball is cleared after Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Betis earn a corner.
28' What an opportunity! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
24' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
21' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
21' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
15' Betis are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Antony (Betis) neatly controls a decent pass from Cucho Hernandez. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 1:0.
7' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
6' The free kick from long range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) makes a strong challenge and Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.
3' Antony (Betis) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post.
1' The match has just started.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Jesus Manzano was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
